subject: prd/implement-now
statement: The executor shall run each task as a self-contained worker that, given one task charter and repo access, completes the task with no dependence on the invoking session's memory or on any sibling task.
rationale: the worker is the portable, remote-reusable unit
fit_criterion: the worker runs to a green proposal in a harness supplying only a task charter + repo; no sibling/session state is read
